method: Each control judged on 7 independent flags (no aggregate-score classification; a high total never hides a flag gap). Flags derive from evidence_coverage_matrix per-axis scores (>=2 = HAS), v0_3 durable frames, recovered-frame manifest, and regression corpora.

flag_definitions.HAS_VISUAL_EVIDENCE: durable frame(s) exist for the control's state (recovered/review-batch/run screenshots)
flag_definitions.HAS_STATE_DETECTOR: frame-based or anchor-based identity detector specified and evidenced
flag_definitions.HAS_GEOMETRY: normalized box or proven click point with bounds
flag_definitions.HAS_NEGATIVE_REGRESSION: at least one documented no-effect/wrong-target/fail-closed case

classification_rule: SHADOW_READY = all of VISUAL+DETECTOR+GEOMETRY+AUTHORITY+POSTCONDITION >= HAS and replication gap explicitly tracked; PYTHON_READY_CANDIDATE additionally requires NEGATIVE_REGRESSION + CROSS_SESSION_REPLICATION; single missing axis maps to NEEDS_*; business-owned gate maps to BUSINESS_BLOCKED; evidence-conflict maps to HOLD.
